City of Inglewood

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  November 09, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the 1st Floor, Finance Conference Room at
11:30 a.m.:

  Members Present:  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman, City Attorney’s Office
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office (Call-In)

  Staff Present:  Teresa Estrada, Parks and Recreation Community Services
  Ana Ma, Police Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of October 26, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. Lotus Communications, LLC. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for cabling
  services for Police Department in the amount of $2,552.00. Motion carried unanimously.

3. Yorba Linda Feed Store, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for the rental of
  hay bales at Rogers Park in the amount of $1,647.75. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 11:42 a.m. Adjournment
